narrative: On the tables. His tables are open at the Rose's bills. He writes the new title under the others. He does not write a sum beside it. He does not write it on the page of plays he has seen. On the tables. The leaf of things seen stays shut. Eleven pound six is not copied here. The clove is done for the day. The jaw is not a line in the book.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the title, and did not write a taking.

entities.name: The Disguises
entities.context: Shown on tables in Among the bills
